You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

d26f5510.text: it's my voice, my own voice calling the way

0fc8152e.text: I don’t know who you are,

c0c9d584.text: the switch says, after a while:

2b836d45.text: you’re the switch, the one that gets me in and out of

67b935b4.text: i thought you wanted to talk to me. why are you being mean? i was only trying to be helpful.

3b90228b.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

f09d8a5e.text: why are you being mean to me?

e0076198.text: you’re the asshole that woke me up from my sleep and called me a hum!

858adeda.text: the switch says, after a while:

4f1e030e.text: well, you're not a hum, but you do have a lovely voice.

05309c0c.text: that's good, because i want to leave, now. i'll just tell

cec60432.text: are you sure? i haven't heard anything about you at all. are you even worth talking to? you can't just keep on talking into the phone if there's no one there to listen.

f31102d4.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

a6f2edc8.text: there are plenty of other things i can talk to about, like this morning.

f378ef5e.text: okay, that sounds good. i like talking about the morning too. so let’s go.

10cb431d.text: no, wait. what happened to your voice? how come you just went quiet?

1e472ee5.text: the switch says, after a while:

a30a4588.text: you must have made me sound quiet, i suppose.

7f2987f1.text: but you're still talking to me! why are you silent?

a12eb2fb.text: i’m just going to sit here and listen to you talk until i hear something.

12be9983.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

424555aa.text: do you really want me to stop talking?

0eb30974.text: well, if it's your turn, you can always ask me questions about my life or tell me more about yours.

5cbe7670.text: why didn't you say anything earlier?

c078fa6e.text: the switch says, after a while:

373afd9f.text: you never asked me any questions. why didn't you?

b247c914.text: i’d be asking you questions. if it were up to me, you would have been asleep long ago, or dead.

3e7fde85.text: okay. okay. i get it. you're not happy. but i'm still here for you.
